trigger_steps: org.wikipedia.dev is already launched by the runner or setup; do not use launcher search or intents. If onboarding appears, tap Forward until Skip is available, then tap Skip. From the main feed, tap the bottom Search tab (nav_tab_search), then tap search_card to open SearchActivity.
Tap search_src_text, type sentinel text 'zzoversize', and confirm search_src_text shows it. Press system Back once to hide the soft keyboard while staying in SearchActivity.
